[P2] Add regression coverage for duplicate-upload handling

This changes whether duplicate uploads block emulator publication, but no test covers the new setting. Existing workflow tests check dependency wiring and failure gates; removing or disabling this input leaves those assertions unchanged, allowing the release failure to return undetected. Add a focused unit test in `.github/scripts/tests/test_release_workflow_dependencies.py` that reads the actual publish step and requires `skip-existing` to be enabled. This supplies the related unit coverage required by AGENTS.md.
